difficulty_reason: Build Y as the full subcategory of X_T of objects y with V x_X y T -> T surjective; prove the 2-fibre product T x_{x,X} Y is a stack in setoids (faithful inclusion), then representable: the surjectivity condition holds iff f lands in the open image T_0 of the smooth (hence open) map V x_{X,x} T -> T; conclude Y -> X is an open immersion and Y algebraic via the open-fibred-category lemma; finally construct g' : V -> Y using the diagonal section of V x_X V -> V, prove it smooth by base change and surjective by construction.
